blocks.text: Thermochemistry woh ilm hai jis mein hum parhte hain ke physical ya chemical tabdeeli ke dauran kitni heat energy jazb (absorb) hoti hai ya bahar nikalti (evolve hoti) hai. Isi liye ise energetics bhi kehte hain, aur yeh zyada tar thermodynamics ke first law par qaim hai. Hess’ law, jo first law ki hi ek khas soorat hai, chemist ke haath mein ek bohat kaam ka auzaar (tool) hai aur analytical chemistry mein is ke bohat se istemal hain. Thermodynamics yeh bhi batati hai ke koi reaction diye gaye halaat mein ho sakta hai ya nahi, yani reaction ki spontaneity (khud ba khud hone ki salahiyat).

blocks.title: Heat content ya enthalpy
blocks.text: Kisi substance ke andar jo energy us ki banawat (bonds ki qisam) aur physical state ki wajah se hoti hai, use us ka heat content ya enthalpy kehte hain. Is ki alamat H hai.

Har substance ki apni ek khas enthalpy hoti hai. Isi liye products ki kul enthalpy (HP) kabhi reactants ki kul enthalpy (HR) ke barabar nahi hoti. Jab reaction mein reactants products ban jate hain to enthalpy badal jati hai; is tabdeeli ko ΔH kehte hain. Aasan alfaaz mein, enthalpy change woh kul energy hai jo heat ki shakal mein ya to bahar nikalti hai ya andar jazb hoti hai.

blocks.latex: \Delta H = (\text{Heat content of products, } H_P) - (\text{Heat content of reactants, } H_R)
blocks.text_alt: ΔH = (Heat content of products, HP) – (Heat content of reactants, HR)

items: HP < HR: enthalpy kam ho jati hai, is liye heat bahar nikalti hai (HP – HR ke barabar) aur ΔH ka nishan manfi (negative) hota hai.

blocks.title: Exothermic process
blocks.text: Woh chemical reaction ya physical change jis mein heat system se nikal kar surroundings (aas paas ke mahol) mein jati hai, exothermic process kehlata hai.

items: HP > HR: enthalpy barh jati hai, is liye heat jazb hoti hai (HP – HR ke barabar) aur ΔH ka nishan musbat (positive) hota hai.

blocks.title: Endothermic process
blocks.text: Woh chemical reaction ya physical change jis mein system surroundings se heat jazb karta hai, endothermic process kehlata hai.
Figure 6.1 mein exothermic aur endothermic reactions ke enthalpy diagrams dikhaye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Do enthalpy diagrams. (a) Enthalpy axis par HR oopar aur HP neeche; HR par neela 'reactants' level, wahan se surkh teer neeche HP par neele 'products' level tak, saath likha: chunke HR > HP, is liye delta H = manfi (negative). (b) HR neeche aur HP oopar; surkh teer 'reactants' se oopar 'products' tak, saath likha: chunke HR < HP, is liye delta H = musbat (positive). Dono ka x-axis 'Progress of Reaction' hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.1: (a) Exothermic aur (b) endothermic reaction ka enthalpy diagram (kitab ki Figure 6.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein reactants ki line (HR) oopar aur products ki line (HP) neeche hai, is liye teer neeche ki taraf hai: heat bahar nikli, ΔH manfi. (b) mein reactants neeche aur products oopar hain, teer oopar ki taraf hai: heat jazb hui, ΔH musbat.
Misal: carbon ka oxygen mein jalna (combustion) exothermic reaction hai.

blocks.text_alt: C(s) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g)    ΔH = –393.7 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) ka pani mein ghulna (dissolution) endothermic process hai.

blocks.text_alt: NH₄Cl(s) —H₂O(l)→ NH₄⁺(aq) + Cl⁻(aq)    ΔH = +16.2 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) ka pani mein ghulna endothermic reaction hai. Yeh cold packs (ice packs) mein istemal hota hai jin se andaruni choton (internal injuries) ka ilaj kiya jata hai. Pack ko dabane se pani aur NH₄Cl ke crystals mil jate hain, surroundings se energy jazb hoti hai aur thandak mehsoos hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Exothermic reaction mein HR aur HP mein se kaun bara hai, aur farq wali energy kahan jati hai?
blocks.explanation: HR (reactants ki enthalpy) bari hoti hai. Farq HP – HR manfi hai; yeh energy heat ban kar system se surroundings mein chali jati hai, is liye mixture garam ho jata hai.

items: Thermochemistry (energetics) jazb ya kharij hone wali heat ka ilm hai; yeh thermodynamics ke first law par qaim hai aur Hess’ law us ki khas soorat hai.
ΔH = HP – HR. Exothermic: HP < HR, ΔH manfi, heat bahar (C + O₂ → CO₂, –393.7 kJ mol⁻¹).
Endothermic: HP > HR, ΔH musbat, heat andar (NH₄Cl ka ghulna, +16.2 kJ mol⁻¹, cold packs).
